channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Mrunal Thakur walks hand-in-hand with Sidhant Chaturvedi amid wedding rumours with Dhanush
item.description: Rumours of Mrunal and Dhanush getting married on February 14 surfaced online. Adding clarity to the situation, a source close to Dhanush dismissed the wedding rumours, calling the claims entirely untrue, baseless, and misleading.

item.title: AR Rahman calls winning Oscar a "burden"; says he was "gaslighted" in his music career
item.description: A.R. Rahman has opened up about how the industry's obsession with nostalgia and constant comparisons made him second-guess his own work, explaining that even winning two Oscars can feel less like validation and more like a heavy burden.

item.title: J&K: Anti-terror operation resumes in J&K's Kishtwar after night halt; 8 soldiers injured
item.description: Multiple teams of the Army, Jammu and Kashmir Police and paramilitary forces, supported by drones and sniffer dogs, are combing the upper reaches of the forested area to track two to three terrorists believed to be affiliated with the Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammad. No fresh contact has been reported so far. item.title: Shefali Jariwala's husband Parag Tyagi blames black magic for actress' sudden death
item.description: Shefali's husband, Parag, has claimed that he is pretty certain that somebody had performed the ritual of black magic on his wife in her final days, before her sudden death.

item.title: India crushed at home: NZ wins ODI series, Virat Kohli makes century, fans criticize team and coach Gambhir
item.description: The loss sparked widespread criticism on social media, targeting the players, captain Shubman Gill, and head coach Gautam Gambhir. Former opener Wasim Jaffer praised New Zealand's young team for their execution and resilience. Spinner Kuldeep Yadav and other Indian players were specifically criticized for underperforming, while team management and selectors faced scrutiny for their decisions and insistence that the team was progressing despite poor results.

item.title: Silver at lifetime high, hits Rs 3 lakh per kg on MCX amid global tensions: Buy, hold, or sell?
item.description: The metal surged to a record Rs 3,04,087 per kg at 12:29 pm IST, gaining 5.67 percent in a single session. Prices are now up nearly 206 percent over the past year. The previous peak of Rs 2,92,960 per kg was recorded on January 15, 2026.

item.title: Kriti Sanon's rumoured BF Kabir poses romantically with her at Nupur's wedding; fans react to age gap
item.description: On Sunday, Kabir shared a series of pictures from Nupur and Stebin's dreamy wedding on Instagram. For the Christian ceremony, Kriti wore a turquoise blue gown, while Kabir looked dapper in a white tuxedo. Ever since the photos went viral, fans have been buzzing about Kriti and Kabir's age difference.

item.title: Wipro shares faces steepest drop since 2024 amid revenue forecast
item.description: Wipro faces sharp drop in stock value due to revenue forecast, impacting deal wins and market position.

item.title: Papa, save me: Father recounts techie son's final call after car plunges into Noida water filled ditch
item.description: Rescue efforts by police, fire services, SDRF and NDRF were hampered by darkness, fog, freezing water and dangerous under-construction structures. Despite attempts by locals, including a delivery agent who jumped into the pit with a rope, Yuvraj could not be saved.

item.title: Hande Erçel recording Shah Rukh Khan or her friend Amina Khalil: Fans wage social media war
item.description: At the Joy Awards 2026 in Riyadh, Shah Rukh Khan shared the stage with global stars like Millie Bobby Brown and Katy Perry. A viral clip showing Turkish actress Hande Erçel filming on her phone sparked debate, with SRK fans claiming she was recording him, while others said she was filming her friend, Egyptian actress Amina Khalil.
